inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Loose-fill surfacing on the large playground is not installed at the six inch depth required based on the highest play surface on the operation's playground. There are also several places on the same large playground that are bare of loose-fill.    Add loose-fill to attain a depth of six inches uniformly around the entire play structure surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: Several small pieces of trash were found on the out door activity space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver in infant room did not wash hands after changing an in fants diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A three month old infant was sleeping in a swing. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the infant from the device and placed the child in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 Survey data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual report has not been done for this year. The last report was 03/22/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two caregivers were observed in the classrooms without an eligible background check. The director removed both caregivers from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: Follow Up:   I observed that the children did not have cups for their water during active play only a cooler with some water in it. This was corrected at inspection when  the director brought some cups outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: Janitorial duties: I observed a caregiver cleaning a classroom while she had 5 children in care. The caregiver was the only caregiver in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A 5 -month-old infant was sleeping in a swing.   Note: A picture was taken. The caregiver did remove the child from the swing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: Based on the investigation, water was not provided during active play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, the caregiver drove off from a school leaving the children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, parents were not notified regarding children left unsupervised out of a school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two  infant feeding sheets were not updated within the 30-day requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that the van driver did not use the list of children that were being transported. The list that was available for review did not show the child name on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that the caregiver did not know the children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Operation did not report to licensing that a child was injured at operation that needed medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: In the infant classroom I observed two bowls and bottle in the hand washing sink. A photo was taken. This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the bowls and bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: I observed 3 month old infant sleeping in a swing. A photo was taken and the caregiver removed the infant from swing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation for supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Caregivers with hire dates 04/30/2021 and 05/31/2022, were present in the classroom with children, did not have a background check. A volunteer was also present at the operation without a background check. The volunteer had been at the operation for 2 weeks without a background check.  The director had all the caregivers leave the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: I observed a waterhose on the sidewalk in which children had access to. Photos were taken.     This was corrected when the waterhose was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the preponderance of information obtained during the investigation there is sufficient evidence to support a citation for supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver did not display good judgment when a chair was pulled from under a child after a game of musical chairs, which caused the child to fall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: I observed that the yellow climbing tunnel  had a large crack. A photo was taken. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation did not complete an incident report for the parent to sign.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operation did not report the incident within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is enough evidence to support a citation for ratio not being maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Based on information obtained during the investigation, monthly fire drills were not conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is enough evidence to support a citation for ratio not being maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)
